awards.title: Nominee for the GUF100 Award
awards.summary: Every year during the Ceremony of Merits, the best students at our University are put in the spotlight and presented with the GUF-100 prize. I was part of the three nominees from the Faculty of Science and Engineering for the 2024 edition and the 2025 edition of the award.

awards.title: Teaching Assistant of the Year

awards.summary: Each year, a single teaching assistant from the studies of Mathematics and Applied Mathematics gets voted "Teaching Assistant of the Year". I was presented with this award for the 2022-2023 academic year.
